title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-maya-2
content:
Daily scratchpad - Partnerships / Marketplace (quick notes, TODOs, reminders)

Context: working on two pilot partner integrations this week  DataBridge (analytics connector) and CloudForge (marketplace provisioning). Quick sync notes and individual next steps. Mostly a personal checklist; will formalize into a one-pager once blockers cleared.

OVERVIEW
- Goal: unblock PoC integrations for both partners by end of sprint (Mar 10).
- Success metrics: 1) end-to-end request flow through adapters, 2) integration tests passing in staging, 3) cost estimates for production routing.

HIGH-PRIORITY ITEMS
- DataBridge:
  - [ ] Confirm auth flow: API key vs. OAuth (requested final decision from DB legal on 3/2). 
  - [ ] Schema mapping doc: finalize sample payload mapping for embeddings + metadata (draft in Confluence link above).
  - [x] Get sample dataset from partner (received 2/26).
  - [ ] Add rate-limit handling in adapter (Samir to own; ticket JIRA-PRT-423).
  - Blockers: partner needs clarification on PII fields  flagged to privacy team (email sent 3/1).
  - Next step: schedule 30m sync with DB engineering to validate auth and rate limits (tentative Wed 3/6 10:30am).

- CloudForge:
  - [ ] Provisioning flow: define webhook retry policy and idempotency keys.
  - [ ] SSO / SCIM: partner requested SCIM for user provisioning  need SSO checklist from Security (pinged SSO@redwood).
  - [ ] Billing integration: stubbed in marketplace flow, need final pricing fields from CF (awaiting PO).
  - Done: test account created in CF staging (confirmed 2/27).
  - Next step: implement minimal webhook receiver + end-to-end test by Fri 3/8.

INTEGRATION CHECKLIST (quick, personal copy)
- Auth: determine flow (API key / OAuth)  add expiry & rotation notes.
- API surface: list endpoints, rate limits, pagination, error codes.
- Payload: sample requests/responses, required fields, optional metadata, PII flags.
- Monitoring: add logs, traces, SLOs for partner routes in Console.
- Retries: backoff policy and idempotency design.
- Security: TLS certs, SCIM/SSO, KMS config for keys if needed.
- Data handling: retention, delete-on-demand, audit log hooks.
- Tests: unit adapter tests + integration smoke (staging), load test plan (100 req/s sim).
- Rollout: canary timeline + auto-fallback to hosted default model if errors spike.

MEETING NOTES (brief)
- 3/1 sync with DataBridge: partner wants OAuth for long-term, but ok with API key for PoC. They will provide OAuth spec by 3/9.
- 3/2 legal / privacy: need confirmation on allowed metadata fields (expect answer by EOD 3/4).
- 3/3 infra: discussed ephemeral staging cluster quotas  might need a temporary burst quota for load tests.

PERSONAL TODO (today)
- [ ] Draft adapter README and example curl requests (priority).
- [ ] Create JIRA subtask for retry/backoff implementation (assign to Samir).
- [ ] Sync w/ security for SCIM checklist (email + slack ping).
- [ ] Add simple smoke test harness to partner-adapters repo (PR template drafted).

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED
- PoC auth: accept API key for PoC? (pros: faster; cons: security). Need final from Legal/Privacy.
- Canary policy: default 5% traffic for partner routes or start with 1%? Ops prefers 1% initially.

NOTES TO SELF
- Keep the docs minimal for partners; we own the integration complexity.
- Capture any partner-specific edge cases in the adapter README (searchable).
- Remember to update cost model with CloudForge provisioning overhead when we have numbers.

NEXT MEETINGS
- DataBridge engineering sync  Wed 3/6 10:30am (tentative)
- Internal readiness review  Fri 3/8 9:00am

Quick reference links: Confluence spec (link above), PR (adapter) #128, JIRA-PRT-423.

---
Scratchpad end (will convert to formal partner-join one-pager once PoC auth & privacy decisions are done).
